name: Clitomachus (born Hasdrubal)
biography: A Carthaginian who succeeded Carneades as head of the Academy; prolific writer (reportedly over 400 books) who continued Carneades's doctrine of probability and, with him, campaigned against belief in divination, magic, and astrology.
